## 4. CRM WRITE + TASK FOR ADAM (Branch B — fire and forget)
Creates/reuses the contact and company, creates the opportunity and a marketing_attribution row (never ACTUAL — only ESTIMATED/UNKNOWN), links everything back onto the enquiry row, and raises a task for Adam.

Owner alert (21 Nov 2026): once the enquiry row is saved, one internal email goes to noya@ (Build/Send Owner Alert). Nothing is ever sent to the client from this workflow: no WhatsApp, no email.
